description: Compared to the previous version, includes metadata related to citing and cited bibliographic resources added in the [September 2025 version of Crossref](https://api.crossref.org/snapshots/monthly/2025/09/all.json.tar.gz), as well as the [DataCite Public Data File 2025](https://datafiles.datacite.org/datafiles/public-2025).
stats_note: 2,862,406 editors and 106,791,171 publishers (counted by roles, without disambiguating individuals)
